title: A semigroup approach towards the rate of Muller's ratchet (code and data)
description: Code, simulation data and figures for the paper "A semigroup approach towards the rate of Muller's ratchet" by C. S. Heinzel, P. Pfaffelhuber and A. Wakolbinger. An interactive version of Figure 2 / Table 1 is available at https://pfaffelh.github.io/ratchet_figures/ .
